hotel.name: Hôtel du Couvent, a Luxury Collection Hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies a 17th-century convent with a garden in Old Nice.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the old Nice, nestled in the North-Italian part of Provence, lies a convent from the 17th century with a luxurious garden.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located in the pedestrian Old Town of Nice.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are located in the pedestrian Old Town of Nice.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is the former Visitation convent, set in the heart of the old town and overlooking the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the heart of the old town, secluded and overlooking the Mediterranean, the former Visitation convent welcomes visitors into an architecture steeped in the memory of the place.

verified_facts.text: The garden pool looks out over the terracotta rooftops of Nice on one side and the Mediterranean on the other.
verified_facts.excerpt: it offers an unspoiled panorama over Nice, the city’s terracotta rooftops on one side, the shimmering Mediterranean on the other.

verified_facts.text: As a tribute to the Roman bath remains on the Cimiez hill, the hotel has a Roman-inspired thermal circuit.
verified_facts.excerpt: As a tribute to the remains of the Roman baths on the hill in Cimiez, Nice, Hôtel du Couvent presents a Roman-inspired thermal circuit.

verified_facts.text: Bathers in the Roman Baths start in the warm tepidarium, move to the hot caldarium and finish with a plunge in the cool frigidarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: To enjoy the greatest benefits, bathers are invited to start with the warm water of the tepidarium, followed by the hot caldarium, and finish with a plunge in the cool frigidarium.

verified_facts.text: Roman Baths treatments draw on botanical actives that echo the garden and the old convent pharmacopoeia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatments draw on botanical actives, echoing the garden and the convent pharmacopoeia

verified_facts.text: Some suites have large kitchens equipped with Lacanche ranges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some feature large kitchens equipped with Lacanche ranges, while others highlight a spacious living room and dining area.

verified_facts.text: Suites are decorated with bespoke furniture, antiques, sculptures, paintings and rare books.
verified_facts.excerpt: They are decorated with bespoke furniture, antiques, sculptures, paintings, and rare books.

verified_facts.text: Each suite has a dedicated butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite has a dedicated Butler, attentive to your needs throughout your stay.

verified_facts.text: Some suites have a private garden with a dining table, or terraces and loggias overlooking the Cour des Orangers.
verified_facts.excerpt: some suites offer a private outdoor retreat: a garden with a dining table to linger over long summer evenings, or expansive terraces and loggias overlooking the Cour des Orangers

verified_facts.text: Rooms are spread across the convent's three buildings, and interiors and views vary from room to room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spread across the convent's three buildings, each room is unique; interiors and views vary from room to room.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation ranges from monastic-type cells to apartments with a sea view.
verified_facts.excerpt: A wide range of accommodation, from monastic-type cells to 166sqm appartements with a sea view

verified_facts.text: A resident herbalist offers guests personalized guidance, handcrafted remedies and teas made with herbs from the garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel’s resident herbalist offers guests personalized guidance, handcrafted remedies, and artisanal teas infused with herbs from the garden

verified_facts.text: The hotel's own farm, Ferme Notre-Dame in Touët-sur-Var in the hills behind Nice, supplies its kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: In Touët-sur-Var, in the hills of Nice’s hinterland, Ferme Notre-Dame supplies the hotel’s kitchens exclusively

verified_facts.text: Bread is baked on-site in the room where the convent sisters once prepared their daily loaves.
verified_facts.excerpt: the bread baked in the bakery oven located in the very room where the sisters once prepared their daily loaves

verified_facts.text: The Movement Studio runs daily classes including functional training, breathwork, yoga, pilates, floor barre and animal flow.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our daily classes combine diversity and effectiveness, offering a variety of disciplines: functional training to strengthen the body, breathwork to calm the mind, yoga, pilates, floor barre, and animal flow.

verified_facts.text: During school holidays the hotel welcomes children aged 4 to 10 for a supervised programme.
verified_facts.excerpt: During school holidays, Hôtel du Couvent welcomes children from 4 to 10.

verified_facts.text: Plage du Galet on the Promenade des Anglais reserves sunbeds for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the Promenade des Anglais, Plage du Galet welcomes guests for a relaxing day by the Mediterranean. Sunbeds are reserved for Hôtel du Couvent guests.

verified_facts.text: A documentation centre on the convent's ground floor holds works on fine arts, sculpture, religious art and Nice's culinary traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the ground floor of the convent, the documentation center offers a valuable selection of works on Fine Arts, sculpture, religious art, as well as the culinary traditions of Nice.

verified_facts.text: Drivers reach the Old Town entrance at 2 rue Centrale, and the valet service can escort guests to the hotel if called before arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: Arriving by car, go to 2 rue Centrale, in front of the Jean Jaurès bookshop, to access the Old Town entrance. You can also contact our Valet Service on +33 6 85 83 10 33, 15 min prior to your arrival to escort you to the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds a Michelin Key.
verified_facts.excerpt: Michelin Key 2026

verified_facts.text: One Saturday morning each month, the Cour des Orangers hosts a market of local producers.
verified_facts.excerpt: One Saturday morning each month, the Cour des Orangers hosts a market of passionate local producers

verified_facts.text: The terraced, listed gardens and cloisters overlook the city rooftops and the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy a tranquil escape between aromatic orchards and swimming pools, all while overlooking the rooftops of the city and the Mediterranean Sea.

verified_facts.text: La Guinguette serves lunch and drinks in the vegetable garden, near the pools and the open-air cinema.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy lunch, stay for a drink or all afternoon amidst the vegetable garden, between the flower and herb-lined terraces, a stone’s throw from the pools and open-air cinema.

verified_facts.text: Certain suites can be interconnected for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Certain suites can be interconnected, providing ideal flexibility for families.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.

verified_facts.text: Guests are welcomed under the linden tree among ancient stones, wisteria and the courtyard's orange trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: they find themselves at the heart of this centuries-old site, among ancient stones, wisteria shade, and the scent of the courtyard’s orange trees. Guests are received under the linden tree

unresolved.text: The hotel was ranked No. 38 and won the Art of Design Award in The World's 50 Best Hotels.
